author_reading.workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
author_reading.rationale: Johnson (twisted-ring) counter crosses with a clean depth-2 chain per bit; it has cross-bit shift feedback but no binary arithmetic, so unit-step encoding is not provable from RTL.

labels.workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
labels.rationale: The feedback shift is cross-bit-dependent state without a modeled arithmetic update. Ordinary Johnson steps change one bit, but the supported encoding proof does not establish crossing safety.
labels.suspected_flaw: Synchronous source reset from states such as 1111 can force several bits low together while the destination runs. Reset coordination is unspecified.

labels.workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
labels.rationale: Register j_q[3:0] in src_clk updates as a 4-bit twisted-ring (Johnson) sequence (j_q <= {j_q[2:0], ~j_q[3]} at design.sv:16) and is synchronized bit-by-bit into dst_clk via s1_q -> s2_q (design.sv:19-20). Because j_q has cross-bit state dependence without a live binary arithmetic update or recognized Gray binary-to-Gray conversion, unit-step encoding safety is unestablished (CDC-017 WARNING Unresolved).
